units.name: Unit DCSSR

power.logic_voltage_status: do not derive GPIO logic voltage from the 5V supply label

protocol.summary: DC SSR controller with ESP32C3, three modes (manual button / I2C slave @0x50 / RS485 Modbus @0x04), programmable SK6812 RGB LED, 10A DC24-220V load, isolated SSR. unit/acssr.py implements ACSSRI2CUnit (0x00 on/off, 0x10 RGB, 0xFE firmware, 0x20 set address) and ACSSRModbusUnit; unit/__init__.py aliases DCSSRUnit to acssr.
gaps: Modbus mode is a separate RS485 path not modeled by the Unit attachment

claims: ACSSRI2CUnit address 0x50; 0x00 on/off, 0x10 RGB, 0xFE firmware, 0x20 address

units.blocker: U140 has an official Unit driver (unit/acssr.py) and a clear I2C 0x50 register subset, so a minimal relay/RGB model is implementable. Modbus @0x04 is a separate RS485 path not modeled by the Unit attachment; SSR 10A/DC24-220V/isolation/switching life/thermal are NOT RUN. 0152/next implementation should keep planned until guest evidence.
limitations: Modbus RS485 mode is outside the Unit data plane and not modeled.
SSR electrical/thermal/isolation/switching-life behavior NOT RUN.
0x50 must be checked against other I2C units on the same bus.
